description: Why: manual delegation duplicates 30 lines of boilerplate that the macro already generates correctly for AzureStore and GcsStore. A future refactor that changes IpfsStore signatures will require updating WebDavStore separately. What: webdav_store.rs has a manual #[async_trait] impl IpfsStore for WebDavStore with three methods each delegating to self.0. AzureStore and GcsStore use crate::impl_ipfs_store_via_inner!(TypeName) for the same pattern in one line.
title: WebDavStore manually reimplements IpfsStore instead of using impl_ipfs_store_via_inner! macro
